Actually, I should focus on the light blues instead: Vermont belongs to p1, who has plenty of cash but mortgaged assets, so I'm considering offering around $130 for it since light blue houses are cheap to build and could yield decent rent. I'd rather not give up a railroad since I only hold two, so a straight cash offer seems like the better approach to propose.
